iconicAnchor.label: Collateral and the electronic urban night
iconicAnchor.creatorOrTradition: Michael Mann; BFI Sight and Sound analysis
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: BFI's discussion of Collateral identifies the taxi as a viewing environment for nocturnal downtown and electronic night, a useful cinematic anchor for in-vehicle urban depth.

sources.title: Twenty-first century noir
supports: Collateral uses a taxi viewpoint and electronic urban night to make nocturnal city travel a cinematic environment.

sources.title: The Essential Reference Guide for Filmmakers
supports: Shutter angle and exposure time govern motion blur and the clarity of moving subjects and lights.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches windshield point of view, road vanishing point, dashboard glow, passing light, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/night-drive/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
